_comment: Daily quests (Boss 2026-11-21: the Quests panel has a DAILY page). PO defaults, PLACEHOLDERS the Boss can change here without code. The day turns over at reset_hour_utc (17 = 00:00 Bangkok time) on the SERVER clock (the same unix time every server command already gets as state.now); progress and claims of an older day count as 0. Counters are recorded only by the authority at a run's end (logic/journey.gd pay_card_xp): stat fights = runs finished (won, lost or retreated), waves = waves cleared (the boss wave counts on a win), bosses = runs won (the zone boss beaten). reward = gold paid into the stash by the daily_claim command, once per quest per day.
